question: An electric heater rated 1000 W is used for 5 hours daily. For cost per unit of Rs. 6.00, calculate the total cost for running the device for the month of September (in Rs.).
solution:
The correct answer is __**900**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The power consumption of the electric heater per day is 1000 W * 5 hours = 5000 Wh or 5 kWh.
 
• There are 30 days in the month of September.
 
• Total energy consumption for the month = 5 kWh/day * 30 days = 150 kWh.
 
• The cost per unit (kWh) is Rs. 6.00.
 
• Total cost = 150 kWh * Rs. 6.00/kWh = Rs. 900.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Electric heaters are typically used for heating spaces and can consume a significant amount of electricity.
 
• It's important to consider the cost of running high-power devices for extended periods to manage electricity bills effectively.
 
• Using energy-efficient devices or limiting usage can help reduce electricity consumption and costs.
 
• Regular maintenance of electrical appliances can also improve their efficiency and reduce energy consumption.
